name: traces_server_latency_p99_anomaly
title: Server span p99 latency is unusually high
description: The p99 duration of SERVER spans across the traces stream is above its learned weekday/weekend hour-of-day band in at least 2 of the last 3 five-minute buckets. Tail latency is noisier than p95, hence info. Unit: microseconds. Whole stream; add a service_name filter after install for a per-service alert (one config per service). Needs applications sending OpenTelemetry traces to the traces stream named default.
